notes:
History panel, text objects, new snaps and document tolerances.

### New
- History panel beside Layers and Properties: every step is listed by command name; click a step to go back or forward. The number of steps is set in Preferences.
- TextObject: create curves, surfaces or solids from text with any installed font, height, bold and italic.
- Center snap works from the edge of circles, arcs and circular edges, and on closed planar curves and planar surfaces; new Quad snap; AreaCentroid and VolumeCentroid commands.
- Document tolerances (absolute and angle) in Document properties, used by modelling operations and saved with the file.
- Radius or Diameter for Circle, Arc, Sphere, Cylinder, Cone, Torus and Pipe; Scale asks for its origin point.
- Gumball: press Alt while dragging to switch copy on or off; Ctrl suspends snaps.
- Mesh wires preference: Automatic, Always or Feature edges only.

### Improved
- Export opens as a movable window with a mesh preview in the views.
- Consistent option bar: every option shows Name=value in one style, and round-size tools share the same prompts.

### Fixed
- Trim and Split work with curves lying on the faces of a solid.
- The TextObject preview no longer draws stray lines inside letters.

---
Windows x64 installer with signed automatic updates and the corresponding AGPL source code. The installer is not Authenticode-signed: on first install choose **More info > Run anyway**.
